definition: Recraft is a generative artificial intelligence program and service developed by the London-based startup Recraft, Inc.
details: The company also offers Recraft Studio, a web-based workspace that lets users create and edit images, vectors, and mockups using various text-to-image models. Like models such as Midjourney and DALL-E, the Recraft model generates digital images from natural language prompts, and is specifically tailored for creative workflows, with features that emphasize brand consistency, text fidelity, and layout control.

explainer.lead: Recraft is a generative AI program and service developed by the London-based startup Recraft, Inc. It matters for creative workflows where brand consistency, text fidelity, and layout control are required.

tiers.eli5: Like an image generator built for designers, one that keeps the logo and wording on-brand instead of improvising.
tiers.practitioner: Users generate digital images from natural language prompts and edit images, vectors, and mockups in Recraft Studio, a web-based workspace. A pitfall is expecting general-purpose prompting to hold brand consistency without the controls the tool provides for it.
tiers.paperLevel: A generative program and service from Recraft, Inc. that generates digital images from natural language prompts, alongside Recraft Studio for creating and editing images, vectors, and mockups with various text-to-image models.

explainer.example: A designer writes a prompt, then refines the result in Recraft Studio, adjusting layout and text to match a brand.
